items.caption: ## 8 Non-Negotiables # Greet & Farewell ### *Happy staff, happy customers.*
## It's important to keep customers happy by engaging them. To do this, greet all customers that walk past or make eye contact with you and/or with the store.
## Team members are expected to be friendly, inviting, smiling, engaging, and well presented.
## There should be a minimum of 1 team member to be present at POS at all times.

data.title: <m> <b> **Do or Don't?**

slides.templateDescription: Display a long amount of content

data.content:
Do

  • Greet all customers within 3 seconds that walk past or make eye contact with you and/or with the store.

  • Thank all leaving customers.

  • Always be friendly, engaging, and well-presented.

Don't

  • Assign 1 team member to be present at POS only during peak hours.
